Additionally, the coloration is not uniformly emerald green (yellow snout). While the classifier ranked 'green mamba' #1, the visual evidence strongly suggests a misalignment with the specific species morphology, likely generating a generic green tree snake instead. Only 3/6 testable checkpoints passed (Eyes, Ventral Color, Scale Gloss).
